decision_opportunities: Exactly the PM1A Up-token close-anchored common-eligibility opportunities before future-book qualification
future_lookup: Latest Up book captured strictly after decision and no later than decision+15s; target capture age <=5s; valid two-sided unlocked/uncrossed book; no target if any condition fails.
target: future best-bid/ask midpoint minus current decision-time midpoint, in probability points
frozen_primary_metric: equal-market mean squared error of probability-point repricing, paired market bootstrap
baseline: B0_zero_repricing: predict no change in current midpoint
same_information_rule: B2 and B3 use identical eight-by-eleven causal PM1A history tensor on identical PM1B-qualified opportunities
training_weights: each market has equal total training weight; evaluation averages within market then equally across markets
model_selection: Only train/dev may select or early-stop; final future changes remain unopened until code, settings and fitted models are frozen and pushed
interpretation: A PM1B gain predicts transient repricing, not terminal information or execution profit; PM1A results remain separate.
limits: Collector snapshot time, sparse changed-book rows, four sampled dates and a partial final day; no independent WSE confirmation.
